events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago this month, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the game. What's your favourite track from their debut? We're taking your calls!

events.title: Woodstock Festival: 57 Years On
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day, August 15, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Festival Flashback
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people gathered for three days of peace and music at Woodstock. Which iconic performance would you have loved to see live?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on this day in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the one and only Elvis Presley. His music continues to inspire generations. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Birthday Shout-out
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and style are unmistakable. What's your go-to Pretenders song?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Birthday Buzz
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite tune featuring that iconic voice?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', which took place on this day in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Trivia
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! From Sean Connery to Daniel Craig, who's your favourite 007 and why?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician and peace activist John Lennon was born on this day in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon Legacy
angles.copy: Today, we remember the visionary John Lennon, who would have turned 86. His message of peace and incredible music live on. What's his most impactful song for you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite moment from his incredible career?
